text:
Lina (Product): Quick thread to align on launch readiness for enterprise evidence exports + BYO key parity across regions. Need concrete acceptance tests and a short rollout plan we can show Sales/legal. Thoughts?

Raj (Infra): TL;DR: two big engineering asks: 1) export manifest must include cryptographic proof (signed manifest + checksums), 2) retention lanes need a deterministic purge pipeline per region. Without that, customers will ask for proofs we can't give.

Carmen (Security): Agreed. For manifests we should use an independent signing key (not tenant key) plus include per-file SHA256 and KMS-audit-id. For BYOK tenants we include a KMS-wrapped-encryption-metadata block so auditors see we never held plaintext. No escrow.

Eve (Legal): Important: contract language for BYOK must say Redwood never has plaintext and we will provide signed evidence bundles on request. Need to draft a clause for pilot customers and a standard clause for GA. Also clarify e-discovery / legal-hold obligations: we can pause retention TTLs only with a signed legal-hold request.

Marco (Sales): Customers want two variants: immediate evidence export (for audits) and bulk archived exports (for e-discovery). Pricing: immediate export included in top enterprise tier, bulk archive billed per GB with a minimum. Also asking for regional parity: EU customers insist data stays in-region for exports.

Raj (Infra): Regional parity is doable but doubles storage+export infra in some cases. Suggest MVP: region-aware exports where manifest flags origin region and export endpoint selectively proxied. Full in-region archival replication to be Phase 2.

Lina (Product): Let's craft acceptance tests we can run with pilot customers. Proposed list: 
- A1: 90-day sample export returns signed-manifest.json + bundle.tar.gz with checksums; manifest includes encryption metadata and KMS-audit-id.
- A2: Retention TTL respects legal-hold flag (apply hold -> data not purged for 30 days).
- A3: BYOK handshake completes without Redwood ever seeing plaintext keys; testable via handshake logs.
- A4: Export completes within SLA window configured per tenant (24h standard, 6h enterprise).

Carmen (Security): Add A5: manifest signature verifiable by customer using our published public key; include example verification command in docs. Example: `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature manifest.sig signed-manifest.json`

Raj (Infra): For A4 SLA we need priority export workers and a backpressure policy (token bucket per tenant). Cost estimate: +20% CPU/IO for launch quarter. Will provide numbers.

Marco (Sales): Pilot ask: can we provide a proof-of-concept export for AcmeBank next week? They want to validate signature + manifest schema. I'll coordinate.

Eve (Legal): Also check cross-border export restrictions for that customer. If data can't leave EU, we need EU endpoint only. Marco, get me customer-specific residency requirements.

CS Bot: Note: Runbook template created: https://internals.redwood/cs/runbooks/evidence-export-template (draft).

Lina (Product): Docs and SDK examples required. Raj, can infra provide a sample curl + response payload for the A1 test?

Raj (Infra): Yes. Sample API contract: `POST /v1/exports` body: `{"range":"90d","format":"signed-tar","priority":"standard"}` Response: 202 + `{"export_id":"exp_123","eta":"2025-04-03T04:00:00Z"}` Then GET `/v1/exports/exp_123` returns `{"status":"ready","manifest_url":"https://s3.redwood/exp_123/manifest.json","bundle_url":"https://s3.redwood/exp_123/bundle.tar.gz","manifest_sig_url":"https://s3.redwood/exp_123/manifest.sig"}`

Carmen (Security): For manifests include `encryption_metadata` object with `kms_key_arn`, `wrap_algorithm`, and `kms_audit_id`. Also include `redwood_signature_kid` so customers can pick correct pubkey.

Lina (Product): Good. Timeline proposal: 
- This week: Security threat checklist + sample verification commands (Carmen)
- 2 weeks: Infra POC for signed export + sample API (Raj)
- 3 weeks: Pilot with 2 customers (Marco) + CS runbook validation
- Legal to draft BYOK/hold clauses concurrently (Eve)

Marco (Sales): Will confirm pilots (AcmeBank, NovaFin) by EOD tomorrow.

Eve (Legal): I'll produce an initial BYOK clause and a legal-hold process doc in 5 business days.

Raj (Infra): Note: for BYOK HSM-strict mode we need partner APIs (CloudHSM/KeyVault). That path will be gated by Phase 2 due to integration and FIPS concerns.

Carmen (Security): Final ask: acceptance tests must be reproducible offline by auditors. So include checksum list in manifest and ensure bundle.tar.gz uses deterministic ordering.

Lina (Product): Finalized acceptance criteria: A1-A5 from above + deterministic bundle. If everyone OK I'll create an RFC and the release checklist and tag owners. :white_check_mark:

CS Bot: Reminder created: "Evidence export pilot kickoff" Fri 10:00. Invites: Lina, Raj, Carmen, Marco, Eve.
__notes: Slack thread format: single text field with chronological messages prefixed by sender name. No title field included.
